scope: Full64lane HTTP baseline for bottleneck diagnosis under recorded shared-host pressure; not performance qualification or adoption; original quiet-admission matrix remains required
sampling: greedy temperature0, original EOS and original request max_tokens
exclusion_policy: none; failure aborts whole attempt and preserves every row; no retries or slow sample removal
correctness_policy: Riley exact frozen token/text/finish reference; all engine input/output counts and transport exact; cross-engine arithmetic differences recorded
post_screen_required: measured optimization batch of 2-5 related changes
host_gate_revision_reason: Diagnostic only: record3 prephase observations and truthful quiet flag; do not abort solely on pressure; retain every measured row including slow rows. No pooling with admission-controlled attempts.
startup_timeout_scope: cold initialization only; captured logs and host samples; excluded from serving timing by explicit warmup and retained phase envelopes
